intro: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Zardeth of the Black Claw protects a hidden warlock cabal from scrutiny. He dwells in the chambers beneath the Slaughtered Lamb and poses as an ordinary patron. When curious nobles look too closely, he makes sure their inquiries end for good.

p: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, tunnels shelter those who practice darker arts while the Mage Quarter's spires study arcane discipline in the open. Zardeth of the Black Claw works from these crypts, guarding warlocks who hide right beneath the city guard's nose. The Alliance condemns fel magic, so the cabal survives by keeping its presence secret and removing threats before royal investigators arrive.
